title: What the Engine Did
dialogue: Dusek requested a classified briefing. Voss was not invited.
monologue: Voss was not invited. That is the first signal that what the engine was used for is something Dusek does not want the man who built it to know about.

narrative.text: The engine decrypted fourteen months of Tyvaren northern border command communications. The intelligence was operationally significant. I am prepared to brief you on the details under classification level four.
I wanted you to know before Voss asks why his engine is running continuous operations rather than research cycles. He will notice. He notices everything.

voss_military_use_brief.monologue: Fourteen months of Tyvaren military communications. Dusek is right — Voss will notice the operational cycle. He will know what it means. The question is whether I tell him before he figures it out himself.

choices.text: "Tell Voss what it is being used for. He deserves to know."
"Keep it classified. Voss is a civilian technical consultant — operational use is outside his remit."
